Indian Standard

DIMENSIONS FOR 

COUPLINGS FOR OIL AND FUEL RECEPTION FOR 

INLAND VESSELS

1. Scope — Lays down the mating dimensions of coupling for fuel and oil reception on vessels. 
These devices are applicable to inland and harbour vessels as well as port installations used by these 
vessels. 

1.2 This standard does not apply to the corresponding devices for cargo system of vessels intended for 
the transportation of petroleum products. 

2- Nominal Sizes — The couplings shall be of four sizes corresponding to 50, 80, 100 and 150 nominal 
diameter of pipes for use on vessels of various tonnage and types and shall be designated as DN50, 
DN80, DN100 and DN150 respectively. 

3. Dimensions — The dimensions of the principal mating parts shall be as given in Table 1, 
Fig. 1 and 2.

IS: 11339 -1985 

EX PL AN A TOR Y N OTE 

This standard lays down the dimensions for 4 sizes of couplings for oil and fuel reception for 
inland vessels and port installations. This standard has been formulated with the aim of unifying 
mating dimensions of filling devices on board ships for lubricating oil and liquid fuels. Observance of 
the specified dimensions in the corresponding couplings in ships and port bases will facilitate the 
process of the filling ships with fuel and oil and reduce the labour and time expended for this pupose. 

In the preparation of this standard considerable assistance has been derived from 
ISO 3926-1980 'Shipbuilding — Inland navigation — Couplings for oil and fuel reception — Mating 
dimensions, issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ). 



Printed at Arcee Press, New Delhi, India
